lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: So, did he put her in the jeep?

lines.text: And again, how did he pick her up and put her in the jeep?

lines.text: The same way he did, with the, in the bedroom.

lines.text: Did you open the back of the jeep? So he could put her in there?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Why did he put her in the back of the jeep? What did he say?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He said that he was gonna try to crush it before anybody noticed.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What changed his mind? Do you know?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: So then he carries, he takes her out of the jeep and puts her back on the floor and decides to take her out to the fire.
